name: Requests Sigstore Signature
description: This identity requests a Sigstore keyless signing certificate from this Fulcio CA — the cert-request step of the keyless flow: the CI workflow presents an OIDC token to Fulcio, which issues a short-lived signing cert bound to the workflow identity; the workflow then signs with the ephemeral key and logs the signature in Rekor. Named specifically (REQUESTS_SIGSTORE_SIGNATURE, not a generic 'requests signature') to disambiguate from other signing schemes a workflow may use in future. The source is unconstrained (wildcard): any workflow/identity that presents an OIDC token to Fulcio can request a signature — the edge deliberately does not bind to a single CI platform's node type. Target is the Fulcio CA node.
